Eli K: Quick capture from today's multi-site postmortem: stakeholders want a provable 'cost provenance' record when we divert traffic for active/active failover. Need minimal implementable plan.

Marisol V: Proposal: attach immutable routing metadata to every request: home_region, exec_region, billing_policy, parent_id (if fanout). Persist in traces + request logs.

Tadeo R: Practical: edge can stamp fields and sign them with edge-key. Downstream services must validate signature before using headers for billing. Use header names: X-RW-Home, X-RW-Exec, X-RW-Policy, X-RW-Sig.

Marisol V: Also include a short signature TTL in the header (ts). Reject stale signatures >2 minutes to limit replay.

Eli K: For async tasks, copy the signed metadata into the task payload. Workers validate on dequeue and emit a task-level audit event linking back to parent request.

cust-legal-bot: Legal note: for residency customers we need an exportable audit bundle (home+exec+timestamps+sig) for 3 years. Add retention tier options.

Tadeo R: Reconciliation: daily batch joins region_costs to enriched logs, uses billing_policy per-tenant to pick attribution window. Hybrid policy example: first 45s charged to exec_region, remainder to home_region.

Marisol V: UX: Console should show a 'provenance' toggle and an events timeline when exec != home. Also surface policy per tenant and a 'request audit export' button.

Eli K: Threats: header spoofing and rogue proxies. Mitigation: HMAC-SHA256 signed by KMS key, verify at collectors, rotate keys quarterly. Note in RFC.

Tadeo R: Owners & rough sizing: edge stamping+signing (5d), collector validation + schema (3d), task payload propagation (3d), recon job (5d), console + export (3d). Parallelize.

task-bot: Created ticket #5227: "cost-provenance headers + signed metadata for multi-region billing" and assigned to Tadeo R.

Eli K: I'll add this checklist to the RFC follow-up: header spec, signature scheme, retention tiers, recon algorithm, console mock, tests (failover + fanout). Ping me for review.
